sentences.text:
In case if the advocate for the applicants chooses to remain absent on the next date of hearing i.e.
10.7.2025, the Court shall be constrained to take up the matter even in their NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/4952/2025 ORDER DATED: 10/07/2025 undefined absence with the assistance of learned APP.

"
2. Today also, when this matter was taken-up for hearing, learned Advocate, Mr.
Shah, appearing for the petitioner was not present.

Hence, this Court was constrained to taken-up this matter for hearing in the absence of learned Advocate,
Mr. Shah, with the assistance of the learned APP.

3. By way of this application, filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as "BNSS"), the petitioner has prayed for quashing and setting aside the F.I.R., bearing I-CR No. 11191020200162 of 2022,
registered with Vastrapur Police Station, Ahmedabad, under Sections 406, 420, 465,
466, 467, 468, 471, 114 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code and the charge-sheet as well as all other consequential proceedings arising out of the aforesaid FIR, qua the applicant.
4.

Upon perusal of the material on record, this Court finds that the impugned FIR was filed on 13.02.2020 by one Vishnubhai Nagjibhai Rabari against about ten persons, wherein, it is stated that the complainant, who is engaged in business, was introduced by his friend Gokulbhai to the present petitioner, who projected himself as a builder and developer.

Thereafter, the complainant was shown a plot of NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/4952/2025 ORDER DATED: 10/07/2025 undefined land in Bodakdev area and the complainant was offered a scheme of partnership in respect of the scheme flats on the said plot.

Accordingly, the complainant became a partner in the partnership firm, namely Optimize Infracon,
and a scheme of flats in the name of Optimize Elegance was floated.

4.1 It is, further, stated in the impugned FIR that, as per the partnership deed, the amount towards investment was sought from the complainant and other partners,
but, the same was not deposited and therefore, the firm had to borrow the amount from the market, at higher rate of interest.
Thereafter, the amount borrowed from the third parties were deposited and kept in the firm, as unsecured deposit.
4.2 Ultimately, the flats were sold by the firm to various persons, but, the amount received towards the same was not deposited in the account of the firm.
On 30.05.2016, a new firm was created and all the rights were given to the present complainant.
4.3 It appears that, in the meantime, some proceedings were also initiated under RERA, as the amount collected towards the allotment of the flats was not deposited in the firm.
Ultimately, as stated in the impugned FIR, out of sale consideration of about 26 flats, i.e. an amount of NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/4952/2025 Patel Hitesh Joitaram vs State Of Gujarat on 10 July, 2025

ORDER DATED: 10/07/2025 undefined Rs.12,00,00,000/-, was siphoned by the present petitioner and the other co-accused and that is how the impugned FIR came to be filed.
Hence, the present petition.

5. At the outset, learned APP, Mr. Raval, placed on record a report dated 09.07.2025,
filed by one Mr. S.J. Jadeja, Police Inspector, Crime Branch, Ahmedabad City, and by referring to the same, it was pointed out that the present petitioner had executed various notarized agreements and thereby, allotted the flats and collected the money,
but, did not deposit the same with the firm.
It was, therefore, submitted that a prima facie offence is made out against the present petitioner.
The aforesaid report also indicated that qua accused Nos. 3 to 9, a summary report is filed, however, the same has not been accepted / finalized, yet.

5.1 Learned APP, further, submitted that in view of the fact that the charge-sheet has already been filed and prima facie offence is disclosed against the present petitioner,
i.e. the petitioner siphoned an amount of Rs.12/- crore, received by him towards the allotment of flats, on the basis of the forged documents, and hence, this Court may not entertain this petition.

6. I have heard the learned APP and perused the material NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/4952/2025 ORDER DATED: 10/07/2025 undefined on record and I find that from a bare reading of the impugned FIR, a prima facie offence is disclosed against the present petitioner and now, even the charge-sheet has also been filed which would make out a prima facie offence and therefore, the petitioner is required to face the trial.
7.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed in limine.
However, the trial Court shall not be influenced by any of the observations made herein above, which are of tentative nature, and the present dismissal shall not come in the way of the petitioner.
Rule is discharged.

(NIRZAR S. DESAI,J) UMESH/-
